Now part of Yahoo Finance Gold. # Broadcom Stabilizes After Google's $120 Billion Marvell Shock. Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO), the semiconductor and infrastructure-software powerhouse, rebounded approximately 0.4% to $363.93 Thursday afternoon after getting hammered 4.6% Wednesday. Investors are starting to separate Google's (NASDAQ:GOOG) decision to add another chip partner from the much biggerand far less dramaticquestion of whether Broadcom is actually losing its existing TPU empire. Marvell could receive warrants tied to roughly $120 billion of qualifying Google purchases through fiscal 2033. Google is building a second lane, but Broadcom remains firmly on the highway. The AI prize is also expanding too quickly for this to become a simple winner-takes-all fight. Marvell may squeeze Broadcom's exclusivity and strengthen Google's bargaining power, but it has not ripped out Broadcom's deeply embedded engineering advantage.
